output.summary: Group ticket time of about 17.6 minutes is a documented, board-accepted tradeoff of the 2024 Made Here redesign. It began in October 2024, is under the 19-minute ceiling, and came with higher satisfaction, check, same-store sales and margin. The 12-minute benchmark comes from a panel of pre-prepared-menu chains, so it is not comparable. The Riverside spike, to about 31 minutes, tracks the saute/pasta cook's departure and the unfilled slot. Group operations deferred two transfer requests. Why he left is disputed, so blaming the GM is unsupported. Par-cooked standardization and a 12-minute bonus are harmful given the failed trial and the bumping seen in the 2023 incentive scheme. Fix Riverside staffing and keep the group baseline.
